title: Pushing the Primordial Frontier: Exact Linear Solutions in Multifield Inflation
summary: We present exact analytic solutions for the linear dynamics of a two-field inflationary system in which the primordial curvature perturbation $ζ$ is coupled to an isocurvature perturbation $σ$ of entropy mass $μ$. The solutions are valid for arbitrary values of $μ$ and the dimensionless interaction strength $λ$, within a quasi-de Sitter background. They therefore provide analytic control over the strong mixing regime in which $ζ$ interacts with light isocurvature fields, commonly associated with rapid-turn inflation.
